title: Vampire Vape Koncept Purple Craze 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: This Purple Craze Shortfill from Vampire Vape offers the ultimate blend of two classic flavours: Heisenberg and Pinkman. With the sweetness of red berries and mixed fruits, alongside the cool menthol breeze and aniseed edge of Heisenberg, this flavour creates a refreshing, fruity, and cooling vape experience. This 100ml shortfill bottle is nicotine-free but allows space for two 10ml nic shots. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 18mg nic shots and shake well. The 70VG/30PG ratio makes this e-liquid ideal for sub-ohm vape kits, providing dense vapour and full-bodied flavour.
